reason: 512 whole native Apps peak ~350MiB; directly hosting20k full client Apps would exceed8GiB host. This does not establish server capacity failure.
method: Actual native server with N simultaneous native ConnectedClient/AuthorizedClient identities.
Native protocol-hash handshake packets are generated by a native prototype; every replay must independently produce exactly those packets.
Native unreliable mutation ACK byte predictions read only the flags/index header; server consumes those predictions on the specified reliable FIFO schedule.
Record every S2C message and expected C2S response per recipient and logical tick, including delayed/duplicate messages.
After generation, instantiate a fresh actual native client per recipient and replay every recorded logical tick through its decoder.
Compare its complete emitted C2S messages byte-for-byte with every prediction before admitting the run; compare complete dataset with the model at every tick.
An ACKed packet target must already be reflected in the applied dataset at that replay tick. Native parsed/retained ACK semantics alone do not prove application.
Any mismatch fails the entire run; never substitute sampled recipients or successful-only records.
phases: server generation/update and queueing separately timed
all-client native replay verification separately timed
whole process CPU/RSS includes retained traces and all oracle work; not library-only memory
scope: Deterministic causally verified simulation of 20k server peers, not20k live sockets or20k simultaneous client Apps. Every ACK prediction must match exhaustive native replays. No engine speed acceptance until Rill gets matching input/framing/time/verification and isolated paired runs.
